analysis.headline: Shares Your Data for Ads
analysis.quote: We may share limited categories of personal data (online identifiers and product-related information used to display appropriate ads) with these third parties for cross-contextual advertising purposes, as defined under California and other applicable U.S. state laws.

analysis.headline: Shares Data with Partners
analysis.quote: We may also share data and cooperate with partners such as social media providers who, if allowed in accordance with laws, can use information related to you to help us build more relevant audiences.

analysis.headline: Shares Threat Intelligence
analysis.quote: We may also share threat intelligence with other security companies and experts to improve our threat detection models.

analysis.headline: Shares with Affiliated Companies
analysis.quote: As a result of such transactions, and for maintaining a continued relationship with you, we may transfer your Personal Data to a related affiliate.

analysis.headline: Retains Your Product Data
analysis.quote: After the uninstallation, we will continue to process your Product Data for statistical purposes for up to six years.

analysis.headline: Collects Your Device Details
analysis.quote: Device Data includes information about the operating system; hardware; city/country location of device; IP address, device error logs; browser; network; applications running on the device, including the Avast products.

analysis.headline: Transfers Your Data Globally
analysis.quote: The servers that are part of this infrastructure may therefore be located in a country different than the one where you live. In some instances, these may be countries outside of the European Economic Area (“EEA”).

analysis.headline: Uses Your Data for Personalization
analysis.quote: We use relevant Billing Data, Account Data, Product Data and your answers from surveys, in which you can participate, to personalize our offers, communication and product recommendations.
